messages:
emma (Docs): heads-up — opened a docs PR for the sealed-site installer. Needs a quick sanity pass on the network matrix, HSM mapping, and the isolated-lab runbook. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 :eyes:

sam (Platform): on it. is this targeting the v1 sealed-site flow or the new edge-ns flow?

emma (Docs): v1 flow + a short appendix about edge-ns differences (just links). want to make sure the kube-proxy and CNI notes are correct for kube 1.27 clusters.

li (Security): quick security note — the HSM section references 'pkcs11-path: /usr/lib/hsm/libpkcs11.so' which is fine for ubuntu-ami, but we should add a note for RHEL (lib64 path) and for vendor-supplied fwlibs. Also we should call out minimum TLS ciphers for KMS endpoints.

kevin (PrivOps): added an example snippet for mapping HSM roles to service accounts, landed in the PR as a small patch. snippet:```yaml
hsm:
  pkcs11_lib: "/opt/hsm/lib64/libpkcs11.so"
  slot: 1
  token_label: "redwood-hsm"
  role_mapping:
    - svc_account: "redwood-installer"
      hsm_role: "kms_sign"```

sam (Platform): re: kube-proxy — we should recommend "IPVS mode" for high-conn workloads and include the kube-proxy flags we use in prod. added this note to the PR comment.

emma (Docs): thanks. also found one broken link (internal network-port matrix) — doc-lint flagged it.

doc-lint-bot: link-check: 1 broken link detected (https://confluence.redwood.ai/internal/network-port-matrix -> 404). Please update or add a redirect.

li (Security): I'll add a brief block about KMS rotation: call out that when rotating keys on the HSM you must first update the key policy in KMS then perform the HSM import with the staged key. short checklist is in my comment.

kevin (PrivOps): tested the installer in sealed-lab (dual NIC, no outbound). two observations: 1) need iptables NAT rules for egress proxy chaining (we usually show nftables); 2) systemd unit needs TimeoutStartSec increased for slow disks. small patches in PR. logs:```bash
journalctl -u redwood-installer -f | sed -n '1,120p' ```

sam (Platform): for the network matrix: can we add a tiny table mapping ports to services (control-plane, kms, hsm, image-mirror)? that helped QA.

emma (Docs): yes — I'll add a compact table and include an example nftables -> iptables conversion note (since many customers are still on iptables-legacy).

li (Security): approve from security side once the RHEL/lib64 path and TLS cipher notes are added.

kevin (PrivOps): verified that the HSM pkcs11 path patch covers vendor X and Y. +1 from me after doc-lint link fix.

emma (Docs): ok i'll push the link fix + table + the RHEL notes in the next commit. tagging @sam and @li for a last quick look. thanks everyone :tada:
